# Where Mictlāntēcutli works now: the myths behind the markets
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Mictlāntēcutli** never stopped working.

Mictlāntēcutli's myths are few but pivotal. He guards the bones of the previous creation, and the future of humankind depends on outwitting him.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **3 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Mictlāntēcutli
- **Pantheon:** Nahuatl
- **Domain of influence:** Lord of Mictlān, Death, Underworld
- **Pattern seats:** 3
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Culture & Entertainment
- **Strongest seat:** Funerary & Memorial Services
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 151 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Bones of the Old Age.** After the Fourth Sun perished, Quetzalcōātl descended into Mictlān to retrieve the bones of earlier humans so that the gods could fashion a new race.  Mictlāntēcutli agreed, on condition that Quetzalcōātl walk four times around his realm blowing a conch shell that had no holes. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**The Nine Descents.** The dead do not immediately reach rest.  For four years they travel downward through Chiconahualópan, 'The Place of the Nine Deserts' or nine hills: winds, mountains, jaguars, icy winds, arrows, stones, water, snakes, and lizards. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Funerary & Memorial Services

*Funeral care, memorials, and legacy services. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Lord of the land of the dead; the Mexica afterlife’s keeper.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Music, Arts & Performance

*Music, theatre, dance, and the performing arts. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

*Metal bands, muralists, and cartoonists return to him as the dignified keeper of mortality; the skull aesthetic of whole genres descends from his death cult.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services

*Astrology apps, tarot, and spiritual guidance. (Sector: Society & Spirit)*

*The keeper of the dead whom Quetzalcōātl had to outwit; necromancy, the esoteric economy's oldest practice, is the art of treating with him.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Mictlāntēcutli performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Mictlāntēcutli's myths are few but pivotal. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in funerary & memorial services, music, arts & performance, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/mictlantecutli/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
